reviews.why: The approved strike was pushed into formal government mediation rather than executed: BHP requested mediation with Chile's Labor Inspection on 2026-10-05, and the window opened 2026-10-08 for five business days, extendable by five more, so no walkout has happened. Copper markets read the move as de-risking — CPER gained on the news — and copper trades near $6.66/lb as of 2026-10-10, down from the September record and far from the $6.15 kill level, with the mediation outcome itself still open.
